messages.S2・S3の自傷で自分の体力を積極的に削り、体力が0になるダメージを受けた瞬間に: A Bleed Pierce attacker that aggressively loses HP through S2 and S3's self-damage. Upon taking otherwise lethal damage, she enters the Changing Room and returns in enhanced Full Makeover form. That transformed state is where she reaches full strength.
messages.試着室への入り方: パッシブ「試着室の中へ…」により、体力が0になるダメージを受: **Entering the Changing Room**: Through the passive Into the Changing Room..., when she takes damage that would bring her HP to 0, she does not take it and gains 2 Changing Room instead (once per battle). However, HP-reducing effects from basic skills cannot drop her below 1 HP, so to enter the Changing Room she must take damage that would reduce her HP to 0 from something other than self-damage.
messages.自傷: S2・S3は使用時に脈動回数が足りなければ、新装の有無に関係なく不足分を: **Self-damage**: When using S2 or S3 without enough Pulsation Count, she pays the shortfall with HP regardless of Full Makeover (S2 up to 10, S3 up to 15; 3% of max HP per missing point). In addition, without Full Makeover, she spends 20% of her HP before attacking. The Defense skill Of Course... There was Meaning to this World After All also spends 20% of her HP at Combat Start without Full Makeover, and grants +10 Aggro next turn.
messages.試着室: 速度1固定、スキルによる被ダメージ-50%、体力最大値分のバリア、ター: **Changing Room**: Speed fixed at 1, −50% damage taken from skills, Shield equal to her max HP, and 10 Aggro at Turn Start. She can only use the dedicated Defense skill As the Voice Says, I Gladly Withdraw into Myself. If Changing Room is 0 at Turn End, she enters Full Makeover and gains 5 Pulsation Count.
messages.新装: 速度+1、体力最大値の25%分の体力増加、スキルによる被ダメージ-10%: **Full Makeover**: +1 Speed, HP increase equal to 25% of max HP, −10% damage taken from skills, and +1 Bleed Potency inflicted by basic skills. S2 and S3 gain damage, reuse a Coin once, and heal HP when the reuse hits. The combat passive Cradle of Change (1 Wrath, 1 Lust, and 2 Envy Owned; unlocked at Uptie Ⅱ) also heals 8% of her HP on basic skill hits during Full Makeover, 5 times per turn.
messages.S1は序盤に向かない: S1は現体力80%以上なら脈動回数5を得るため、S2・S: **S1 is poor early on**: S1 grants 5 Pulsation Count at 80% or more current HP, which reduces S2's and S3's self-damage and delays the Changing Room.
messages.序盤はS2・S3を優先し、S1は守備に入れ替えて自傷で体力を削る。体力が低くなっ: Early on, prioritize S2 and S3, swap S1 for her Defense skill, and wear down her HP with self-damage. Once her HP is low, take damage that would bring it to 0 (using enemy one-sided attacks or Unbreakable Coins) to enter the Changing Room (below 50% HP, all of S3's Coins become Unbreakable Coins, letting her strike back while taking hits). Equipping her Defense skill at 10% HP or less also lets her enter the Changing Room, but it throws away that turn's actions, and per the data, entering the Changing Room through damage taken no longer triggers in that battle. After Full Makeover, fight with healing and Coin reuse to balance damage and survivability.
